note: No queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service for Hughes County or its cities (Pierre, Fort Pierre) was found after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online and web searches. Hughes County's zoning district map (2014 comprehensive plan Figure A-1) and the City of Pierre zoning map (2018) and Fort Pierre zoning map are published only as static PDF maps, and the county's Beacon parcel viewer does not expose zoning districts. Zoning is therefore viewer-only/PDF-only.
